properties.title: Google, Q2 2026 bulletin: 158 takedowns, more than in any of its previous 8 periods (28 to 91)
properties.summary: Outside Google's own record, not rated unusual: Google disclosed 158 takedowns in its Q2 2026 bulletin, against 28 to 91 (mean 47.1) in its previous 8 periods (bulletin (quarter)). The rule puts 2 of Google's 3 rated periods outside their range (67%); a period is rated unusual only while the rule puts no more than 5% of them outside, so this item is routine. This counts what Google chose to disclose, not how much influence activity there was. Rule: a publisher's period whose count is outside the range of its own trailing 8 periods is outside that publisher's own record, never a reading of activity level. It is rated unusual enforcement (tier anomaly) only while the rule puts no more than 5% of that publisher's rated periods outside their range; otherwise the item is routine. A period still being filled is never rated below its range. The origins counted are where the operators were, as Google states them; an origin is never a finding of who directed it.
